unlisted_practices: Rubric-based evaluation of open-ended health agent responses using an expert-aligned Boolean rubric taxonomy with an adaptive router

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks RubricsTree, an expert-aligned evaluation framework and guardrail/feedback mechanism for personal health agents, assessing its alignment with human physicians and its utility in improving model outputs.
